units: CNY billion, shares billion, per-share CNY

sensitivity_metadata.effective: year 1 (2026-10-26 onward), consolidated business and listed parent
sensitivity_metadata.margin_minus_2pp: all years operating margin -2pp; revenue, tax, capex, NWC, payout policy, discount fixed
sensitivity_metadata.credit_delay: additional .6 year1 NWC, returns year3; all operating inputs fixed; financing/dividends recomputed
sensitivity_metadata.park_overrun: parent park capex +30%, no additional sales; all other inputs fixed
sensitivity_metadata.internal_settlement: parent transfers .6 to subsidiaries year1, no group cash cost; profits unchanged
sensitivity_metadata.no_upstream: subsidiary dividend zero all years; legal reserves and liquidity recomputed
sensitivity_metadata.terminal_cash_delay: at year10 excess financial assets released 3/5 years later, earn 1.3% net meanwhile; operating value and years1-10 dividends frozen
sensitivity_metadata.structural: permanent demand decline, margin compression, credit costs and tax; committed park still paid; no automatic recovery
sensitivity_metadata.cyclical: two years weak sales/margin, working capital release year3-4; park commitments retained
sensitivity_metadata.optimistic: new products scale with higher margins and NWC, same park, higher mature ROIC
